Skilling recipes

Every skilling recipe the allocator considers — bars, arrows, potions, cooked fish, and everything else with an XP gate. The "Skilling supplies don't consume slots" toggle applies to all of these by default, which is often too broad. Uncheck a row to exclude that recipe from allocation entirely.

Filler intermediates

Small-margin, fast-fill entries — their slot use is effectively zero when the "Filler intermediates + fast-fill components don't consume slots" toggle is on. Includes both filler recipes (godsword blade, blessed spirit shield, zamorakian hasta) and bulk components (crushed infernal shale) that barely affect the parent craft's margin. Uncheck a recipe row to exclude that recipe from allocation entirely; uncheck a component row to remove it from the fast-fill pool.
